$comment: S0 entry artifact (plan R3, decision-wjc). Every Canon module is classified with a stated reason; canon:audit fails if a module is unclassified or reasonless. This file is the gate an unattended run can observe, replacing a captain approval turn.

project.name: brain-calendar-service
project.shape: headless TypeScript sync daemon + MCP stdio server; no UI, no web framework, no Postgres
project.canonAdaptation: Canon's canonical biome.json does not parse under any currently installable Biome (verified against 1.9.4, 2.4.16 and 2.5.15) even though Canon's own package.json declares @biomejs/biome ^2.4.0. S0 therefore carries the minimum mechanical renames needed to parse, each declared with its reason in scripts/canon-audit.mjs, and files the upstream defect as a canon-extension item rather than working around it silently.

repository.note: New repositories start local and publishing is held: no origin is configured and none may be invented without the captain asking. Name is 'brain-calendar-service' per the captain's correction (task-uzrc2 inbox 002), superseding the earlier 'calendar-service' suggestion in inbox 001. The plan names no repository.
repository.locationHazard: Deliberately NOT under ~/code. ~/code is the root of a pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml, root package.json 'remotion-videos', 45 remotion-* members), so a standalone repo placed there has its pnpm install silently resolve against that workspace instead of itself. Verified: pnpm reported 'Scope: all 45 workspace projects' and installed no node_modules in the repo. An .npmrc with ignore-workspace=true did NOT override it.

modules.reason: Applies verbatim. biome.json copied byte-identical from modules/linting/biome.json with one declared escalation: noExplicitAny warn -> error, because the plan's own rule 1 made 'no any' load-bearing and Canon ships it too weak to stop it.
Copied verbatim, minus the Next.js-16 middleware.ts/proxy.ts guard, which is guarded by a version check that no-ops here. Emoji guard, gitleaks, and the pnpm lock-file guard all retained.
cspell over *.{md,mdx,ts,tsx}; project dictionary carries ical, icaljs, caldav, rrule, recurrence, dtstamp, uid, rdates, exdate, dolt, beads, tzid, vtimezone, freebusy, ics, vcs.

Highest-value module for this project. Circular dependencies and boundary violations as errors is exactly the constraint that stops the sync engine and the transport from entangling. Duplication threshold 8% retained.

Threshold 8% semantic retained; the project targets 0% duplication across adapter implementations. The adapter exemption is recorded as an ignore entry carrying a reason, not as a convention (plan rule 6).

Vitest applies and is the primary gate. React Testing Library, jest-dom, Playwright and axe-core are NOT APPLICABLE (headless service) and are deliberately not installed, which would trip Canon's own unused-deps rule. Node-environment project replaces Canon's jsdom baseline; see conflict C5.

Four parallel fast jobs retained; the build job is retargeted per conflict C2 because there is no next build to run. accessibility.yml and e2e.yml are recorded not-applicable rather than created empty.
Reservation discipline retained; directory re-pointed from supabase/migrations to migrations/ per conflict C4, which the module's own Conflicts clause sanctions.
Conflict C3. The service delegates all provider authentication to the gog CLI (Google OAuth lives there), and has no end users; there is no login page and no session proxy.

Conflict C1. Canon mandates Supabase Postgres server-side; the approved architecture makes Dolt/Beads authoritative and explicitly rejected a second source of truth. Replaced by Dolt schema migrations plus a generated Dolt row-type file (pnpm run gen:dolt-types). At S1 the migration allocator was re-pointed, the schema declared in src/adapters/dolt/schema.mjs, and db:verify + a 10-test round-trip suite run against a real (disposable) Dolt server.
No UI in the service. Tailwind, shadcn, CVA and lucide apply in full to a future operator UI, which is a separate project.
Same as styling. next-themes needs a React tree this service does not have.
Same as styling. Worth a stage of its own later if an operator UI is built; the Plan My Day lineage in project-g8dq makes that a real future want, but not now.
No transactional email. resend and react-email are not installed.
Service, not product surface. posthog is not installed; product analytics belong to a UI, if any.
@sentry/nextjs is not applicable; plain @sentry/node for the daemon is, and lands when a long-running process exists (S6). Source maps and env-aware config apply as written.

Zod is load-bearing here, not decorative: every MCP tool input, every external provider payload and every patch_json exception must validate at the boundary. It is NOT installed yet - installing an unused dependency at S0 is exactly what trips Canon's own unused-deps rule - and it lands with the first boundary-validated payload. date-fns is display-only at the edges; ical.js owns all recurrence and timezone arithmetic (conflict C6).

bindingRules.rule: no file over 250 lines outside the allowlist
bindingRules.enforcedBy: .husky/pre-commit size guard (warn), size:check at S9 (merge condition)

bindingRules.rule: zero circular dependencies, zero boundary violations
duplication below 8%, adapter code held to a much lower bar
bindingRules.enforcedBy: fallow duplicates.threshold=8 plus a suppression declared in .fallowrc.json and justified with a reason, a removal condition and an owner in docs/health-exemptions.json

bindingRules.rule: one convention commit per stage, description <= 100 chars
nothing built before its stage entry condition; a stage is done when its exit command exits 0 and its evidence artifact is committed
bindingRules.enforcedBy: stage template entry check + evidence/stage-NN artifact asserted by the next stage's suite

bindingRules.rule: no silent degradation: every caught error is a typed state that fails its stage unless allowlisted with reason, expiry and approval
deny-by-default write path: SyncPolicy allowlist, ownership token required for DELETE, quarantine with no automatic exit
bindingRules.enforcedBy: type structure; unowned delete is unrepresentable

bindingRules.rule: irreversible actions pause for a human
bindingRules.enforcedBy: stage template stop list (4 named actions)

boundaryRule.note: sync/ may never import a concrete adapter; it receives them injected. Enforced as fallow boundary-violations: error.

humanGates: Destructive cleanup of pre-existing external events.
Any write to a calendar outside the SyncPolicy allowlist.
A schema migration against the fleet-shared Dolt server.
Resolution of a specific quarantined conflict.

largeFileAllowlist.scripts/canon-audit.mjs: S0's conformance gate plus AGENTS.md's generator. Splitting them would put the thing that checks conformance in two files, which is worse than one file 35 lines over a soft cap. Revisit at S9 when the guard becomes a merge condition: split then, or raise the cap knowingly.
